subject: Solaris Health — PO structure for annual commitment and monthly statement format
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@solarishealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@solarishealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: PO and billing format for 2027 annual commitment

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of details before we issue a PO for the annual commitment:

1) PO reference: they need a single master PO but split across three Solaris cost centers (ENG-OPS, CLINICAL, DATA). Can Redwood accept multiple PO lines that reference a single contract?
2) Invoice cadence: Solaris requires monthly statements consolidated by cost center, with individual invoices only for exceptions. Can we provide a monthly statement (summary invoice + line-level CSV) and net45 payment terms?
3) Advance/credit requests: for our first quarter they asked if we can provide an advance credit lane (pre-funded credits) for anticipated burst usage. Is that supported on the Dedicated plan?

If helpful I can attach the draft PO template and procurement notes.

Appreciate quick confirmation — procurement is targeting issuing the PO by EOW.

Best,
Alex
Alex Cho
Director, Vendor Ops
Solaris Health
procurement@solarishealth.com

Attachment: Solaris_PO_Draft.docx (stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@solarishealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and billing format for 2027 annual commitment

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vanessa (billing) and Tessa (account lead) to confirm operational details. Quick answers up front:

- Multiple PO lines tied to one master contract: yes, we can accept that. We require the PO to include the master contract number and then the cost-center line items as separate line entries so our billing system maps charges correctly.
- Monthly statement + CSV: supported. We can deliver a consolidated monthly statement per cost center and include a line-level CSV for import into Solaris ERP.
- Advance/pre-funded credits: this is possible under a short-term prepay arrangement; requires a one-time invoice and updated payment term on the invoice (prepay = due on receipt). For Dedicated customers we can also offer a reserved credit bucket that draws down and reconciles on the monthly statement.

Vanessa — can you confirm whether the reserved credit bucket requires any changes to our billing cadence or SOW language? Tessa — Alex indicated procurement wants the PO this week; is a signature-ready SOW attached enough to proceed?

Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@solarishealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and billing format for 2027 annual commitment

Hi all — quick operational notes from billing.

1) PO structure: please include the following fields on the PO so our finance system maps correctly: contract_id (DL-2026-1023-SH), billing_address, remittance_address, cost_center_code (ENG-OPS | CLINICAL | DATA), and a single master PO number with line-item breakdown. If Solaris prefers separate PO numbers per cost center, we can accept that too but ask that each PO reference the master contract number for reconciliation.

2) Invoice cadence/options: we support three options — (A) consolidated monthly statement by cost center with one payable invoice per statement; (B) monthly aggregated invoices per cost center with line-level CSV; (C) weekly statement (only for high-volume partners). Default is option A. Net terms: standard net45 for Solaris (we can set net30 on exceptions with approvals).

3) Advance credit / reserved bucket: we can provision a reserved credit bucket on Dedicated. Implementation notes:
- One-time prepay invoice (due on receipt) to fund the bucket
- Credits draw down in real time; monthly statement reconciles draws and shows remaining balance
- If credits are unused at the end of the term we can either refund or apply to next term per contract clause

Attachments: Solaris_PO_Template.pdf (attached stub), Draft_SOW_Solaris_2026.pdf (attached stub).

Alex — to make procurement happy I suggest Solaris issues a master PO referencing DL-2026-1023-SH and then either: (1) three cost-center line items under that PO or (2) three PO numbers that reference the master contract. Either option is fine; the key is the contract_id field.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: Solaris_PO_Template.pdf; Draft_SOW_Solaris_2026.pdf

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@solarishealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@solarishealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T13:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and billing format for 2027 annual commitment

Camila / Vanessa — great, thanks. A couple follow-ups from procurement:

- The finance team prefers net45 but wants an exception path documented for net30 on the prepay invoice. Can Redwood include that clause on the invoice or SOW?
- For the reserved credit bucket, Solaris wants a mechanism to top-up mid-term without issuing a separate PO each time. Is a purchase order + change notice sufficient or can we accept a simple portal/top-up request?
- Finally, for cost-center split: Solaris's ERP flags vendor invoices if a PO references more than one vendor-level address. If we use one master PO with three line items, procurement will need a one-line vendor address per cost center to avoid ERP rejections. Would Redwood accept three remittance addresses mapped by cost_center_code?

If you can confirm those three items I can circulate the final PO template to our legal and push the PO out.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@solarishealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@solarishealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: PO and billing format for 2027 annual commitment

Alex — all items confirmed. Summary and next steps: 

1) Net terms / prepay clause: we will include an invoice-level note that the prepay invoice is due on receipt; standard monthly invoices will be net45. We can add an exception path that indicates net30 for prepay invoices if Solaris signs the exception section in the SOW.

2) Top-up mechanism for reserved credit bucket: yes — we support a portal-based top-up request for credits and also accept PO change notices. For procurement convenience, we recommend issuing the initial PO to fund the bucket and then using the portal for ad-hoc top-ups to avoid repeated PO issuance.

3) Remittance/address mapping: we can accept three remittance addresses by including a remittance_address field per cost_center_code. To avoid ERP rejection, please have each cost-center line include its remittance_address and cost_center_code. If Solaris wants separate PO numbers instead, ensure each PO references DL-2026-1023-SH in the contract_id field.

Attachments I am sending: Solaris_PO_Template.pdf (fillable template with the fields Vanessa listed) and Signed_SOW_Solaris_2026.pdf (signature page). Please route the template back with the contract_id and remittance fields filled and I will engage Legal to complete signature.

Next step: Alex — once Procurement sends the completed template I will confirm account setup and provisioning timeline (aiming to provision the reserved credit bucket within 3 business days of cleared prepay).

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
